item.title: Oceanside teen's hand amputated after fireworks explosion
item.description: A 15-year-old boy suffered critical injuries after a firework detonated in his hand in Oceanside, resulting in significant burns and a traumatic amputation of his right hand.

item.title: Mark Wahlberg visits San Diego for opening of new restaurant Flecha Cantina
item.description: Actor and New England Patriots superfan Mark Wahlberg opened his third location of Flecha Cantina in San Diego, which offers a modern twist on traditional Mexican cuisine and celebrates Latino culture.

item.title: Drew Brees selected into Pro Football Hall of Fame Class of 2026
item.description: Drew Brees has been selected to the Hall of Fame Class of 2026, joining Larry Fitzgerald, Roger Craig, Luke Kuechly, and Adam Vinatieri.

item.title: Pair of local, adoptable pooches play for 'Lombarky Trophy' in annual Puppy Bowl
item.description: Puppy Bowl XXII will feature 150 adoptable dogs from 72 shelters across the US, Puerto Rico and the British Virgin Islands, with two San Diego shelter dogs, Leonardo da Barky and Sir Remington Fluffypoo Esquire II, competing for the Lombarky Trophy in a call-to-adoption event.

item.title: Tree branch with beehive falls onto El Cajon roadway, police say to avoid area
item.description: The El Cajon Police Department has advised the public to avoid the intersection of Lexington and Avocado Avenues due to a tree branch containing a beehive having fallen onto the roadway.

item.title: San Diego residents report ongoing problems at city park
item.description: Residents near Colina del Sol Park have launched a petition urging the San Diego City Council to take action to address the increasing crime, drug use, and public drinking in the park, including .

item.title: “Just Glorious”: Medal of Honor awarded to Escondido Korean War Veteran
item.description: Retired Navy Captain Royce Williams, a decorated fighter pilot from Escondido, will receive the Congressional Medal of Honor for his heroic actions during the Korean War, after a lifetime of service and keeping his mission secret for over 50 years.

item.title: DOJ proposes changes to immigration appeals process to dismiss backlog of cases
item.description: The Department of Justice has proposed a new regulation to the Board of Immigration Appeals process that would limit immigrants' options to fight deportation orders, reducing the appeal deadline from 30 days to 10 days and making summary dismissal the default judgment.

item.title: Construction worker injured in local work zone prompts police to ramp up speeding enforcement
item.description: San Diego police and public works officials are increasing enforcement and education efforts in construction zones after a worker was seriously injured in a crash caused by a driver failing to slow down.
